name: Birdeye
description: Birdeye is a customer experience and reputation platform for reviews, listings, messaging, surveys, social, referrals, appointments, payments, and multi-location insights.
agentUseSummary: Birdeye cannot yet be connected through Relay. Its public REST API uses a confidential customer-generated API key plus Business ID rather than delegated OAuth, and safe connector work requires a representative entitled account to establish the key's enabled products, operation set, schemas, and quota contract.

credentialRequirements.name: BIRDEYE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Birdeye API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Customer-generated confidential key stored only in Railway's encrypted credential boundary.

credentialRequirements.name: BIRDEYE_BUSINESS_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Birdeye Business ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Customer account's Business ID paired with the API key.

blocked.label: Collect Birdeye credentials
blocked.description: Relay does not ask for or capture a customer's API key until the credential workflow and representative account acceptance are authorized.

blocked.label: Infer account entitlements
blocked.description: A Business ID or public endpoint documentation does not prove which Reviews, Messaging, Surveys, Social, Listings, or other products the key may access.

blocked.label: Expose raw Birdeye APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, automatic pagination, broad exports, unbounded payloads, and raw provider responses are not permitted.

blocked.label: Access Birdeye data
blocked.description: Businesses, locations, reviews, contacts, messages, campaigns, surveys, listings, social content, referrals, appointments, payments, insights, and every read or write remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Birdeye action is enabled before customer-owned credential and entitlement acceptance.

runtimeSupport.description: No Birdeye wrappers are mounted until an entitled customer key establishes a frozen provider contract.
No Birdeye wrappers are mounted until an entitled customer key establishes a frozen provider contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Birdeye requires a paid or otherwise entitled customer account to generate a confidential API key and Business ID in Settings > Integrations > API. Public documentation says quotas are applied per key and integration availability may require Birdeye support, so no representative authority or schema acceptance is available without prohibited credentials.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should obtain authorization from a representative Birdeye customer, generate a dedicated least-authority key without disclosing it in reports, record enabled products and quotas, inspect read/write schemas without external mutations, and return the frozen credential and capability contract for connector implementation.

evidence.supports: Birdeye documents REST APIs authenticated by a confidential dashboard-generated API key with per-key rate limits that can depend on account plan.
Birdeye documents customer generation of a unique API key under Settings, Integrations, API and notes that a representative may need to confirm integration support.
Birdeye documents pairing the account's Business ID and API key for review retrieval and notes that developer/API visibility may require support.
Birdeye documents the same customer-owned Business ID and API key for immediate external review-request writes, demonstrating that the credential can carry communication authority.
